name: Voidfen

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Whoever abandoned derelict space station in orbit did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
There is money in dark crystals and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
